title: Release
description: A smelter or refiner certifies conformance to a due-diligence audit scheme (OECD Due Diligence Guidance step 4 - the real-world analogue is the RMI's RMAP 'Conformant' designation). A claim, not a confirmation - whether the auditing body is itself legitimate is answered by its entity trust level (OWM-6), not by this schema (spec Sec.5).

standard.description: The basis for the certification, e.g. "oecd-5step" or "rmap".
